mapper.select: SELECT p.productId, p.categoryId, p.prodName, p.price, p.discRate, p.thumbnail, p.brand FROM product p WHERE p.productId = #{productId}

WITH LatestStock AS ( SELECT optionId, changedStock, changeDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY optionId ORDER BY changeDate DESC, logId DESC) AS RN FROM stockLog ) SELECT po.productId, po.optionId, po.prodSize, po.color, po.addPrice, NVL(ls.changedStock, 0) AS changedStock FROM productOption po LEFT JOIN LatestStock ls ON po.optionId = ls.optionId AND ls.RN = 1 WHERE po.productId = #{productId} ORDER BY po.prodSize ASC
SELECT p.productId, pi.imageId, pi.files, pi.sortOrder FROM product p INNER JOIN productImage pi ON p.productId = pi.productId WHERE p.productId = #{productId}
SELECT count(*) FROM product p INNER JOIN wishlist w ON p.productId = w.productId WHERE p.productId = #{productId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO wishlist (wishlistId, createdAt, memberId, productId) VALUES(wishlist_Seq.NEXTVAL, SYSDATE, #{memberId}, #{productId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wishlist WHERE memberId = #{memberId} AND productId = #{productId}
mapper.select:
SELECT r.orderItemId, r.productId, r.rating, r.contents, r.status, TO_CHAR(r.createdAt, 'YY.MM.DD') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(r.updatedAt, 'YY.MM.DD') AS updatedAt,
md.name AS memberName,
po.optionId, po.prodSize, po.color,
ri.imageId, ri.files, ri.sortOrder
FROM review r INNER JOIN orderItem oi ON r.orderItemId = oi.orderItemId INNER JOIN productOption po ON oi.optionId = po.optionId INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.orderId = o.orderId INNER JOIN memberDetail md ON o.memberId = md.memberId LEFT JOIN reviewImage ri ON r.orderItemId = ri.orderItemId
WHERE r.productId = #{productId} ORDER BY r.createdAt DESC, ri.sortOrder ASC
